title: Cleanup scan configurations
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words. For every $j\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le |s|$, running the cleanup machine for $j$ steps from its scan configuration at count $0$ yields its scan configuration at count $j$: the machine is in state $(0,|w|<j)$, the input head is at the saturated position for $j$, the first tape still stores $s$, each scratch tape contains the unary word of length $|s|+1$ with its first $j$ cells cleared, and all work heads are at displacement $j$.
replaced:
For every $j$ at most the candidate's length, $j$ steps of the cleanup
machine from the start of its scan phase reach the cleanup scan configuration
for $j$, with nothing emitted; the overflow flag records exactly whether more
candidate cells than input cells have been consumed.
